ITEM 1 | Cooked leafy greens: broad, wilted, dark green leaves with pale white-green thick stalks, glossy and moist with a limp, soft texture; stalks cut in roughly 5-7 cm pieces, some leaves folded over each other, covering about 35% of the plate's surface in a loose mound roughly 2-3 cm high | 150
ITEM 2 | Cooked green beans: thin, bright-to-olive green strands about 6-10 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, slightly wrinkled and glossy, scattered loosely across the greens and plate edge with a few small brownish flecks of garlic or seasoning among them, about 8% of plate surface, lying flat, 1 cm high at most | 40
ITEM 3 | Oil or cooking liquid: thin, slight sheen visible on the greens and beans with no pooled liquid, barely perceptible film | 5
